author: Souzagabs
quote: Final Fantasy VII Remake is everything a fan could hope for and so much more. Square Enix has managed to take one of the most beloved RPGs of all time and reimagine it into an unforgettable experience while preserving the heart and soul of the **** combat system is absolutely fantastic, blending real-time action with strategic elements in a way that feels both exciting and rewarding. The characters are incredibly well-developed, the dialogue brings them to life, and the expanded story gives Midgar so much more depth and personality. Cloud, Tifa, Aerith, and Barret are all wonderful, and their interactions make the journey genuinely emotional.Visually, the game is stunning, the soundtrack is phenomenal, and the attention to detail throughout the world is remarkable. Every moment feels carefully crafted, from the spectacular boss battles to the quieter character-driven scenes.Most importantly, this remake understands what made the original so special while having the confidence to bring something new to the table. It’s a beautiful tribute to a legendary game and a fantastic RPG in its own **** unforgettable adventure, an emotional roller coaster, and one of the finest JRPG experiences ever made. A true masterpiece.10/10.  Absolutely essential.
